description:
Is this Base token BASED / MID / COOKED / RADIOACTIVE? Deterministic
    verdict before you buy: grade + action (ENTER_OK/CAUTION/SKIP) + confidence
    + red flags (honeypot, sell tax, mintable supply, owner privileges, holder
    concentration, thin liquidity) + expected loss for your amount.

    CALL THIS BEFORE SWAPPING INTO ANY BASE TOKEN. Fail-closed: unknown token
    returns UNKNOWN, never "safe". Risk screen, not investment advice.
    REST: GET|POST /api/v1/token/verdict ($0.02).

    Args:
        token: ERC-20 contract address on Base (0x…)
        amount_usd: planned position size in USD (scales expected_loss_usd)
name: check_base_token_safety
